panels.description:
Advanced-tier options: the ring starts at 0° and runs counter-clockwise, with a wider angular gap between arcs and less translucent ribbons.

`padAngle` is the chord analogue of a node gap and it is **angular** — `series.chord` has no `nodeWidth`/`nodeGap` at all (those are sankey keys). Switch the editor back to Default mode and every option here resets.
